Read `Docs/AgToosa_Agent.md` and `Docs/Master-Plan.md` before changing behavior or backlog.

Use AgToosa slash commands for phased work (`/agtoosa-spec`, `/agtoosa-build`, `/agtoosa-review`, `/agtoosa-ship`). Keep `Docs/Master-Plan.md` updated when closing stories.

DreamToosa hub code lives in `dreamtoosa/`; validate with `python3 dreamtoosa/validate.py` and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
